- SLA & remedies: We’ll provide a written SLA with uptime and response-time commitments plus financial service credits for sustained SLA misses. Instead of termination for two consecutive months of SLA failure, we can agree to a termination right if SLA targets are missed in three out of any six consecutive months.
- Reporting: We’re fine with annual availability/performance reporting aligned to the SLA.
- Security & compliance: We can share our current SOC 2 Type II report, standard DPA (including EU requirements), and documentation of encryption in transit and at rest. We also support a right to a third-party assessment or audit no more than once per contract year, subject to reasonable notice and confidentiality.
- Data handling: We can include contractual data-return/deletion obligations upon termination. Our teams will only request architecture or configuration details that are necessary to deliver the service, and we’re happy to do so under NDA.

If these adjustments work on your side, we can circulate a refreshed term sheet and draft agreement within two business days for your legal review.
